salt-grain.title: Pocket Tools
salt-grain.doc: Themes, Python/Ruby/PowerShell or Bash consoles, layer search and bindkeys for KLayout. Commands: help (console help), merge (native Merge), boxify (rectangular polygons to Boxes), stretch (toggle Partial and Move), move (move whole shapes), union (A union B), intersect (A intersection B), difference (A minus B), reverse-difference (B minus A), xor (symmetric difference) and restart (restart with confirmation). A visible warning indicates that Partial is active: moving edges or vertices changes the shape. The button to return to Move, repeating stretch or entering move disables Partial. Tab completes commands; Tab/Shift+Tab cycles through alternatives without changing multiline Python. Boolean operations require two shapes on the same layer in the active editable cell: click A, then Shift-click B. Python helpers: fit(), view(), cv(), run(), clear() and project(). PDK manager: Work in progress - experimental use, under development and not recommended at this time; pdk help/list/status/install/remove/restart commands are documented in the README. Automated tests use native KLayout with Qt without a visible window; before tagging, manually check A/B clicks, selection rectangles and stretch dragging, plus themes, display scaling and restoring the floating/docked console in Windows. These are pending checks, not confirmed defects.
